summary.text: Liz Reyer is a Democratic state representative from House District 52A, in office since January 2023, who is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota Senate District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Liz Reyer lives in Eagan, Minnesota.
She earned a bachelor's degree in Chinese from the University of Minnesota and a master's degree in political science from Ohio State University.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a researcher and leadership coach.
Reyer represented Minnesota House District 51B from 2021 to 2023, succeeding Laurie Halverson, and has represented District 52A since January 3, 2023.
She is not seeking re-election to the House in 2026.
